description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing 'HiddenApp' entities using Room database in an Android application. It includes methods for observing all hidden apps, inserting, deleting, and checking if an app is hidden based on its package name.

classes.name: HiddenAppDao
classes.description: Data Access Object interface for performing database operations related to HiddenApp entities. Provides methods to observe, add, delete, and check hidden apps.

methods.name: observeAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow stream of all HiddenApp entities in the database.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a HiddenApp entity into the database, replacing any existing entry with the same primary key.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified HiddenApp entity from the database.

methods.name: isHidden
methods.description: Checks if a given package name corresponds to a hidden app, returning true if it is hidden.

calls: androidx.room.Query("SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hidden_apps WHERE packageName = :pkg)")
